sql: SELECT GBIF_DMSGCode(1800, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, 0) AS cell05deg, "year", CASE WHEN species IN ('Alternaria solani', 'Blumeria graminis', 'Botrytis cinerea', 'Cercospora beticola', 'Cochliobolus heterostrophus', 'Colletotrichum lindemuthianum', 'Erysiphe necator', 'Fusarium graminearum', 'Fusarium oxysporum', 'Hemileia vastatrix', 'Phakopsora pachyrhizi', 'Pseudocercospora fijiensis', 'Puccinia graminis', 'Puccinia recondita', 'Puccinia striiformis', 'Pyricularia oryzae', 'Rhizoctonia solani', 'Sclerotinia sclerotiorum', 'Ustilago maydis', 'Venturia inaequalis') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_target, COUNT(*) AS n_occurrences FROM occurrence WHERE kingdom = 'Fungi' AND basisOfRecord IS NOT NULL AND basisOfRecord NOT IN ('MATERIAL_SAMPLE', 'FOSSIL_SPECIMEN') AND occurrenceStatus IN ('DETECTED', 'PRESENT') AND hasCoordinate = TRUE AND hasGeospatialIssues = FALSE AND "year" >= 2000 AND "year" <= 2025 GROUP BY GBIF_DMSGCode(1800, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, 0), "year", CASE WHEN species IN ('Alternaria solani', 'Blumeria graminis', 'Botrytis cinerea', 'Cercospora beticola', 'Cochliobolus heterostrophus', 'Colletotrichum lindemuthianum', 'Erysiphe necator', 'Fusarium graminearum', 'Fusarium oxysporum', 'Hemileia vastatrix', 'Phakopsora pachyrhizi', 'Pseudocercospora fijiensis', 'Puccinia graminis', 'Puccinia recondita', 'Puccinia striiformis', 'Pyricularia oryzae', 'Rhizoctonia solani', 'Sclerotinia sclerotiorum', 'Ustilago maydis', 'Venturia inaequalis') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
